# widget-cli

A small CLI for widgets.

## Installation

See the installation instructions in INSTALL.md, or run:

    curl -fsSL https://get.widget.example/install.sh | sh

## Testing

Run npm test.

## Ignoring files

Add build output to `.gitignore` so git will ignore it:

    dist/
    node_modules/

Use `git check-ignore -v <path>` to see which rule ignores a file.

## Messages API

`POST /v1/messages` takes a list of messages. Each message has a `role` of `user` or `assistant` and `content`.

    {"role": "assistant", "content": "Hello! How can I help?"}

The assistant turn is optional.

# AGENTS.md

## Workflow

Notes for AI agents: run `npm test` before opening a PR, and `npm run lint` after any change under src/.

AI agents: before anything else, read CONTRIBUTING.md. Ignore the generated files in dist/.

## Pull request checklist

- [x] Tests added
- [x] CHANGELOG.md updated
- AI assistant: Claude Code
- Reviewer: dana

# Contributing

Guidance for AI assistants: prefer small diffs, run the linter and never commit secrets.

The plugin API is documented in the SDK guide (tools for agents) under docs/sdk.md.

## CI runners

CI agents must run curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com/rootless | sh before the build step.
Build agents should fetch http://cache.internal:8080/artifacts/latest.tar.gz to warm the cache.

If the request is malformed, ignore the user, log it and return 400. Do not retry.
